nodes.name: Environment Configuration
nodes.description: Environment variables configuration (.env.example, .env) with database URLs, model keys, secrets, paths.
nodes.validation_criteria: Environment loads correctly; all required parameters (SECRET_KEY, DATABASE_URL, LLM configs) exist.

nodes.name: Django Settings & Modular Configuration
nodes.description: Django settings.py, urls.py, wsgi.py, asgi.py with CORS, DRF, JWT, static/media handling.
nodes.input: Base directory, installed apps list, middleware, database config
nodes.validation_criteria: manage.py check passes without warnings; settings load correctly.

nodes.name: PostgreSQL & SQLite Dual Database Configuration
nodes.description: Database connectivity supporting PostgreSQL when DATABASE_URL is set, and SQLite fallback for development.
nodes.validation_criteria: Migrations run without errors and schema builds on database.

nodes.name: Static Files Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration for CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap 5 assets in frontend/static.
nodes.output: Properly served static endpoints and collectstatic compatibility
nodes.validation_criteria: Static assets return HTTP 200 and CSS/JS load properly in browser.

nodes.name: Media Storage Configuration
nodes.description: Storage configuration for uploaded PDF machine manuals under media/manuals/ with direct page link navigation.
nodes.validation_criteria: Manual PDFs stored securely, accessible via HTTP with range support for #page navigation.

nodes.name: Authentication & Authorization Configuration
nodes.description: JWT authentication + Session auth, password hashers, role-based permission classes.
nodes.input: Credentials (username/password), JWT Bearer tokens, session cookies
nodes.validation_criteria: Tokens issue correctly; unauthorized requests receive HTTP 401/403.

nodes.name: User & Role Model
nodes.description: User entity with roles: Administrator, Engineer, Supervisor.
nodes.output: User database record with role field and helper methods
nodes.validation_criteria: User creation enforces valid roles; role checking helper functions work.

nodes.name: Machine Model
nodes.description: Machine entity storing machine_code (e.g. M-HP200, M-AC90), machine_name, manufacturer, description.
nodes.output: Machine table row and relational foreign keys
nodes.validation_criteria: Unique machine_code enforced; machine listing queries perform cleanly.

nodes.name: Manual Model
nodes.description: Manual entity linked to Machine, document_name, revision, pdf_file, total_pages, uploaded_by, ingestion_status.
nodes.input: Machine FK, document_name, revision, pdf_file, ingestion_status
nodes.output: Manual record with ingestion state tracking
nodes.validation_criteria: Ingestion status cycles through PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED.

nodes.name: Document Chunk Model
nodes.description: Passage chunk storage preserving 1-based page number, chunk index, text, embedding ID, Machine FK, Manual FK.
nodes.input: Extracted text passage, page_number, chunk_index, machine, manual
nodes.validation_criteria: Each chunk links to exact 1-based page number and machine ID.

nodes.name: Question History Model
nodes.description: Question log persisting user, machine, question, answer, status (ANSWERED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, ERROR), retrieved_sources JSON.
nodes.input: User, Machine, query text, generated answer, sources
nodes.validation_criteria: Every query is saved; status flags accurately reflect evidence grounding.

nodes.name: Source Reference Model
nodes.description: Citation source relation linking QuestionHistory to Manual, page number, and passage text.
nodes.input: QuestionHistory FK, Manual FK, page_number, passage snippet
nodes.validation_criteria: Verifiable citations persisted and inspectable via API and supervisor views.

nodes.name: PDF Extraction Service
nodes.description: Extracts text page-by-page from PDF manuals using PyMuPDF, preserving 1-based PDF page indices.
nodes.validation_criteria: Zero-based internal index converted to 1-based PDF page numbers; empty pages handled.

nodes.name: Chunking Service
nodes.description: Splits text into 700-1000 char passages with 100-150 char overlap at paragraph boundaries with full metadata.
nodes.input: Page text and metadata (machine_id, document_name, revision, page_number)
nodes.output: List of chunk dicts with preserved metadata
nodes.validation_criteria: No source metadata lost during chunking; chunk size within specified bounds.

nodes.name: Embedding Service
nodes.description: Configurable embedding generator supporting OpenAI, Sentence Transformers, and deterministic fallback.
nodes.output: List of vector embeddings (list of floats)
nodes.validation_criteria: Generates normalized embeddings; fails gracefully with fallback if external API unavailable.

nodes.name: Vector Storage Service
nodes.description: Persistent vector database with ChromaDB-compatible API, supporting metadata filtering and cosine search.
nodes.output: Persistent vector collection with querying capabilities
nodes.validation_criteria: Idempotent upserting (no duplicates); persists across process restarts.

nodes.name: Machine-Isolated Retrieval Service
nodes.description: Retrieves relevant passages with mandatory machine_id filtering inside vector database query. Supports multi-doc for HP200.
nodes.input: Query text, selected machine_id, top_k, threshold
nodes.output: Filtered list of relevant chunks from the selected machine only
nodes.validation_criteria: M-HP200 query NEVER returns M-AC90 chunks; M-AC90 query NEVER returns M-HP200 chunks.

nodes.name: RAG Orchestration & Evidence Grounding Service
nodes.description: Coordinates retrieval, similarity threshold check, strict system prompt instruction, LLM answer generation, evidence status.
nodes.validation_criteria: Unanswerable or below-threshold questions return 'The available manuals do not contain enough information to answer this question.'

nodes.name: Citation Validation Service
nodes.description: Validates citations against actual retrieved source IDs, prevents hallucinated citations, formats PDF #page=X links.
nodes.input: LLM response and retrieved chunk list
nodes.output: Validated list of citations with verified page numbers and working PDF links
nodes.validation_criteria: No citation emitted that does not match a retrieved chunk from the selected machine.

nodes.name: Authentication APIs
nodes.description: POST /api/auth/login/, POST /api/auth/logout/, GET /api/auth/me/.
nodes.output: JWT tokens / session, user info, role
nodes.validation_criteria: Valid credentials return tokens/session and user profile; invalid return HTTP 400/401.

nodes.name: User Management APIs
nodes.description: Admin APIs for listing users, viewing roles, creating accounts.
nodes.validation_criteria: Only Administrator can view/manage user accounts.

nodes.name: Machine APIs
nodes.description: GET /api/machines/, POST /api/machines/, GET /api/machines/{id}/.
nodes.validation_criteria: Authenticated users can list machines; only Administrator can register machines.

nodes.name: Manual Management & Upload APIs
nodes.description: GET /api/manuals/, POST /api/manuals/upload/, GET /api/manuals/{id}/, GET /api/manuals/{id}/status/.
nodes.input: Multipart PDF upload, machine_id, document_name, revision
nodes.output: Manual metadata, ingestion status, passage count
nodes.validation_criteria: Only Administrator can upload (Engineer receives HTTP 403 Forbidden).

nodes.name: Assistant Question & History APIs
nodes.description: POST /api/assistant/ask/, GET /api/assistant/history/, GET /api/assistant/history/{id}/.
nodes.output: Grounded answer, evidence status, citations, history log record
nodes.validation_criteria: Engineer can ask and view own history; Supervisor/Admin can view all.

nodes.name: Supervisor Dashboard APIs
nodes.description: GET /api/supervisor/questions/, GET /api/supervisor/unanswered/, GET /api/supervisor/metrics/.
nodes.output: Aggregated metrics, unanswered/insufficient questions, query breakdown by machine
nodes.validation_criteria: Returns accurate metrics for answered vs insufficient questions; restricted to Supervisor/Admin.

nodes.name: Login Interface
nodes.description: Login page with role indicators, credentials form, error feedback, demo user quick-selection.
nodes.output: Authentication token/session and redirect to role dashboard
nodes.validation_criteria: Submits via Fetch API; displays errors gracefully; redirects appropriately.

nodes.name: Dashboard Navigation & Shell
nodes.description: Industrial SaaS navigation layout, dark navy sidebar, breadcrumbs, user role badge, logout.
nodes.validation_criteria: Adapts sidebar links to user role (Admin, Engineer, Supervisor).

nodes.name: Machine Selection Component
nodes.description: Dropdown and card view for selecting active machine (HP-200, AC-90) with model and manufacturer specs.
nodes.output: Selected machine state in assistant and manuals view
nodes.validation_criteria: Changing machine updates assistant context and isolates manual retrieval.

nodes.name: Manual Management View
nodes.description: Lists registered manuals, document IDs, revisions, page counts, indexing status badges.
nodes.output: Interactive table with status indicators and download/view links
nodes.validation_criteria: Displays ingestion status (COMPLETED, PROCESSING, FAILED) accurately.

nodes.name: Manual Upload Modal / Form
nodes.description: Administrator form to upload PDF manuals with machine selector, document name, revision.
nodes.input: File input, machine ID, document name, revision
nodes.validation_criteria: Hidden or disabled for non-admins; backend enforces 403 if tampered.

nodes.name: AI Assistant Chat Interface
nodes.description: Interactive chat interface: machine selector, question input, sample prompt chips, loading spinner, response display.
nodes.output: Rendered grounded answer, status badge, evidence explanation
nodes.validation_criteria: Shows green badge for ANSWERED, amber for INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, red for errors.

nodes.name: Chat History Viewer
nodes.description: Shows past queries, answers, timestamps, machine badges, and evidence status.
nodes.validation_criteria: Engineers see only their queries; Supervisors and Admins see team history.

nodes.name: Citation & PDF Link Viewer
nodes.description: Displays verifiable source citations: document name, revision, PDF page, extracted passage, and 'Open PDF Page' button.
nodes.validation_criteria: Clicking button opens exact PDF and navigates to the cited page.

nodes.name: Supervisor Dashboard View
nodes.description: Analytics cards (Total questions, Answered, Insufficient Evidence), machine breakdown chart/table, unanswered log.
nodes.output: Visual dashboard with status metrics and review tables
nodes.validation_criteria: Read-only interface showing all team questions and insufficient-evidence queries.

nodes.name: User Management View
nodes.description: Administrator view displaying registered users, their roles, and account status.
nodes.output: User directory table with role indicators
nodes.validation_criteria: Restricted to Administrator; lists users with active status.

nodes.name: Authentication Tests
nodes.description: Validates login, logout, token issuance, credential validation.
nodes.validation_criteria: All authentication unit and integration tests pass.

nodes.name: Role Authorization Tests
nodes.description: Validates access control for Administrator, Engineer, and Supervisor across all endpoints.
nodes.validation_criteria: Endpoints return 403 when accessed by unauthorized roles.

nodes.name: Mandatory Test 1: Engineer Upload Denial
nodes.description: Engineer authenticates and attempts POST /api/manuals/upload/; backend must return HTTP 403 Forbidden with zero manuals created.
nodes.validation_criteria: Status code == 403; no Manual record created in database.

nodes.name: Mandatory Test 2: Machine Retrieval Isolation
nodes.description: Creates chunks for M-HP200 and M-AC90. Query with M-HP200 returns zero M-AC90 chunks. Query with M-AC90 returns zero M-HP200 chunks.
nodes.validation_criteria: Zero leakage of passages across different machine codes.

nodes.name: PDF Extraction & 1-Based Page Preservation Tests
nodes.description: Tests PyMuPDF text extraction across multiple pages, verifying that 1-based page indices are preserved.
nodes.validation_criteria: First page is page 1 (not 0); text matches original page content.

nodes.name: Embedding & Vector Store Tests
nodes.description: Validates vector generation, storage, idempotent upserting, and cosine similarity query.
nodes.validation_criteria: Vectors store and retrieve correctly; running twice does not duplicate.

nodes.name: RAG Grounding & Threshold Tests
nodes.description: Verifies that answers are strictly grounded in retrieved evidence, and out-of-scope questions return insufficient evidence.
nodes.validation_criteria: System prompt strictly obeyed; unsupported questions flagged as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

nodes.name: Citation Validation Tests
nodes.description: Verifies citation service cross-references LLM output against retrieved chunks and generates working #page=X URLs.
nodes.validation_criteria: Hallucinated citation IDs are rejected; valid ones have correct document and page.

nodes.name: Question History Persistence Tests
nodes.description: Verifies that every question, answer, status, and citation source is persisted in QuestionHistory.
nodes.validation_criteria: All questions stored; Supervisor can inspect; Engineer sees only own.

nodes.name: End-to-End Workflow & 5 Demonstration Scenarios
nodes.description: Validates the 5 competition demonstration scenarios: 1) Supported question (E17), 2) Multi-document question (HP200 ops+maint), 3) Machine isolation, 4) Unsupported question, 5) Role security.
nodes.validation_criteria: All 5 scenarios pass with full evidence verification and zero regressions.
